ERA: a present-day place where the Three Kingdoms is remembered — a museum of Han relics, a restored plank road, the Red Cliffs park, an old city wall, a Chengdu teahouse, the Wuhou Shrine, a Guan Yu temple, Baidicheng, the Changban Bridge, a film set, an opera dressing room, a calligraphy class or a festival street.

LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP — her far arm, on the side away from the camera.

overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing; intimate areas covered

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. ONE MAIN FIGURE: she is the only character in focus. Where the place is busy, other people may appear only as small, soft-focus background extras — never posed with her. No logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border. No readable text or numbers. No animals or other creatures.

HANDS: natural human hands, no extra or duplicated limbs; each visible hand joins through its wrist and forearm to the matching shoulder. A hand may stay outside the crop, and fingers may be partly hidden by a grip.

acceptance: User authorized completion and normal fast-forward push to main; preserve generated images without exposure-based regeneration.
